summary: Remainder-aware row partitioning covers all rows, and the timed loop recomputes every local row on each requested iteration.

source_evidence.claim: The iteration count comes directly from -i. Complete local CSR arithmetic occurs inside both clock calls without a validation-only substitute or final-iteration-only guard.

compiled_evidence.claim: The clock-bounded machine code retains multiply/add at 9d9d/9da5 and nested backedges 9dac->9d90, 9dc2->9d60, 9dc9->9d50 for nonzeros, rows, repetitions.
